title: Resolution of Timing Shift (P1 Onset Alignment via phase=2) and Linear PSTH Y-Scale
notes: Timing Shift Root Cause: In PyNWB, stimulus_number=1 corresponds to Fixation (fx, -566ms), whereas stimulus_number=2 (phase=2) corresponds to Presentation 1 (P1 onset, t=0ms). Previous code queried stim_num==1, aligning t=0ms to Fixation onset instead of P1 onset and shifting all signals left by -566ms.

Timing Alignment Fix: Used canonical precompute_condition_onsets(session, correct_only=True) which queries session.get_epochs(phase=2, condition=cond, correct_only=True), establishing exact P1 t=0ms alignment.
PSTH Y-Scale Update: Disabled logarithmic scale on PSTH y-axes per user directive, restoring linear Rate (Hz) scale with floor at 0 Hz (ax_psth.set_ylim(bottom=0.0, top=max_rate * 1.15)).

Re-rendered all 30+ 300 DPI PNG figures across outputs/raster_suites/mt_mst_splus/, outputs/raster_suites/mt_mst_sminus/, outputs/raster_suites/oplusplus/, outputs/raster_suites/v182o_fef51_similar/, and outputs/raster_suites/v198o_fef51_similar/.
